backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing user profiles (Junior/Senior roles), doubt posting with attachments, answer management with notes/video, rating system, leaderboard with points, and authorization using mixins for storage and access control.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (authentication, doubt posting, answers, ratings, leaderboard) to their corresponding frontend/backend files, components, and test IDs with high confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components (Layout, forms, cards, modals), pages (doubts, detail, leaderboard), hooks (queries and mutations), and styling with warm educational color palette.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color variables for light and dark modes, defining design tokens for backgrounds, foregrounds, borders, and chart colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component with TanStack Router setup defining routes for doubts feed, doubt detail, and leaderboard pages with authentication guard requiring Internet Identity login.
frontend/src/components/AnswerCard.tsx: Card component displaying answer details including responder profile, text content, rating stars, attachments (notes/video downloads), and interactive rating input for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/AnswerForm.tsx: Form component for posting answers to doubts with text input, optional notes/video file uploads, and upload progress tracking. Handles file conversion to ExternalBlob and submission via usePostAnswer hook.
frontend/src/components/AnswersList.tsx: Displays a list of answers for a specific doubt using useGetAnswersForDoubt hook. Shows loading skeletons, error states, empty state, and renders AnswerCard components for each answer.
frontend/src/components/DoubtCard.tsx: Card component displaying a single doubt with author info, timestamp, description, and optional attachment image. Navigates to doubt detail page on click.
frontend/src/components/DoubtForm.tsx: Form component for posting new doubts with description text and optional image attachment. Handles image preview, upload progress, and converts files to ExternalBlob before submission.
frontend/src/components/DoubtsFeed.tsx: Displays a feed of all doubts sorted by timestamp using useGetAllDoubts hook. Shows loading skeletons, error alerts, empty state, and renders DoubtCard for each doubt.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper with header navigation (logo, doubts, leaderboard links), user profile display, login button, and footer. Conditionally shows RoleSetupModal for authenticated users without profiles.
frontend/src/components/LeaderboardTable: Displays ranked leaderboard table with user profiles, points, and special styling/icons for top 3 positions. Uses useGetLeaderboard and useGetUserProfile hooks with loading and error states.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: A button component that handles Internet Identity login/logout with visual states (logging-in, authenticated, idle) and clears the query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/RatingInput.tsx: An interactive rating component that allows users to rate answers with 1-5 stars and displays a success message after submission.
frontend/src/components/RatingStars.tsx: A reusable star rating display component that can be either interactive or read-only, showing 1-5 stars with hover effects.
frontend/src/components/RoleSetupModal.t: A modal dialog for new users to set up their profile by entering their name and selecting a role (Junior or Senior).
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance based on the user's identity, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllDoubts.ts: A React Query hook that fetches all doubts from the backend actor as an array of Principal-Doubt tuples.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAnswersForDoubt: A React Query hook that fetches all answers for a specific doubt ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: A React Query hook that fetches the current authenticated user's profile from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetLeaderboard.ts: A React Query hook that fetches the leaderboard entries from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetUserProfile.ts: A React Query hook that fetches a specific user's profile by their Principal ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context with login/logout functionality, identity management, and status tracking using AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/usePostAnswer.ts: A mutation hook that posts an answer to a doubt with text, notes, and video attachments, then invalidates related queries.
frontend/src/hooks/usePostDoubt.ts: A mutation hook that creates a new doubt with description and optional attachment, then invalidates the doubts query.
frontend/src/hooks/useRateAnswer.ts: A mutation hook that submits a rating for an answer and invalidates the answers and leaderboard queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: A mutation hook that saves the current user's profile and invalidates the currentUserProfile query.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark theme colors using an orange/amber color scheme.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/DoubtDetailPage.tsx: Displays a single doubt with its details, answers list, and an answer form for seniors. Includes navigation back to doubts list and loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/DoubtsPage.tsx: Main page showing a hero banner, recent doubts feed, and a doubt submission form for juniors (or info message for seniors). Includes platform feature highlights.
frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardPage.tsx: Displays the leaderboard table with top seniors ranked by points, includes trophy icon, description of how points work, and explanatory UI.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters and sessionStorage values, supporting both hash-based and browser-based routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH, extended theme settings, custom animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing a student Q&A platform with junior/senior roles, doubt posting, answer system, ratings, leaderboard, and implemented features using Internet Identity authentication.
